caption: The drawing features a single metallic object positioned horizontally against a plain, beige background. The object is brownish-red in color, suggesting it is made of rusted or aged metal. On the left side, there is a long, straight pointed rod that tapers into a sharp tip. In the middle, a small cylindrical container is attached to the rod, with a vertical, slightly curved hook rising from the edge of the cylinder. To the right of the cylinder, the metal rod continues and curves into a large, rounded, looped handle, forming an oval shape. The entire object appears to be rendered with careful attention to texture and shading, with the metallic surface showing subtle variations in tone. The composition is centered, with ample negative space surrounding the object, and there are no other objects or details present in the drawing.
title: Candle Sticker
